goals.title: Zero critical catalog findings outstanding
goals.description: Generic audit engine (per-site instances do the running). recs_critical should trend to 0 as fixes ship. Metric binding code-verified in run() but unverified by a recorded run on this generic registration.
directives: Rank critical findings first in recommendations.json
Re-emit unresolved criticals each run until shipped

goals.title: Auto-dispatch actionable findings to the implementer
goals.description: Findings only matter if they reach the implementer queue. Metric binding code-verified, unverified by a recorded run.
directives: Dispatch via framework.core.dispatch, never a local queue path

goals.title: Shrink total audit findings over time
goals.description: A healthy catalog produces fewer findings each audit as prior recs ship. Metric binding code-verified, unverified by a recorded run.
directives: Dedupe findings already queued or shipped so recs_total reflects genuinely open issues

goals.title: Every product people click or a guide links has a working image
goals.description: SHOP-20 (2026-11-11). Rows in the site's protect set (published-article links, verified-human clicks in 30 days, featured) are HEAD-checked every run before any random sample; a dead or missing image there costs product-page quality and once led to a #1 guide pick being deactivated. Off until the site configures protect_set in config/catalog-audit-config.json.
directives: Never deactivate or blank a protect-set row; route it to an image refresh, then a relink, then a person
HEAD-check every protect-set image each run before the random sample
Do not re-flag a row that already has an unapplied migration for the same criterion
